notes: This is a Mo Willems Elephant and Piggie book. The two main characters Gerald (elephant) and Piggie are highly distinctive and will need sourced clip art — Boardmaker generic elephant/pig icons will not match the characters children recognise from the cover. The central theme is Gerald trying (and failing) to dance while Piggie encourages him, so 'try', 'fall', 'teach', and 'dance' are all high-priority fringe words. 'Move' is included as a concrete synonym that broadens expressiveness around the dance theme. Secondary character Piggie should also be sourced as a named character image if used on the board.
